title: Pallet Town
subtitle: Choose a starter, first rival battle, Oak's Parcel

steps.text: Set your starter and add it in Team so the guide shows the right rival teams and battle advice.
Leave your house (check the PC upstairs for a free Potion) and try to walk north into the tall grass. Professor Oak stops you and takes you to his lab.
Pick your starter. Bulbasaur makes Brock and Misty easy; Charmander struggles early but gets Metal Claw at Lv.13; Squirtle is the balanced pick. The rival takes the one that beats yours.
Rival battle 1 in the lab. Spam your attack move; Growl/Tail Whip is a waste.
Walk north through Route 1. The Mart clerk on the path gives you a free Potion. Pidgey and Rattata here are fine early catches once you have Poké Balls.
In Viridian City, the Poké Mart clerk hands you Oak's Parcel. Take it back to Professor Oak in Pallet Town.
Deliver the parcel: Oak gives you and your rival the Pokédex. Rival's sister Daisy (rival's house) gives you the Town Map.
Back in Viridian City, buy Poké Balls (at least 5) and a couple of Potions. Antidotes help in Viridian Forest.
Old man in Viridian City demonstrates catching, then the Pokémon Center-side house: the man on the north exit gives the Teachy TV.
Potion (item ball) — Near the city's north exit, west of the small tree

Viridian Gym is locked until you have 7 badges. Route 22 (west) has the first optional rival battle once you have a Pokémon around Lv.8+ — see chapter 2.

title: Extras & completion
subtitle: Vs. Seeker rematches, starter ultimate moves, event islands, finishing the Dex

steps.text: Vs. Seeker: every route trainer can be rematched with stronger teams (up to four tiers). Route 12-15 and Sevault Canyon rematches give the best experience.
Cape Brink house (Two Island): the tutor teaches Frenzy Plant / Blast Burn / Hydro Cannon to your fully evolved starter if it has max friendship.
Navel Rock (Lugia Lv.70 and Ho-Oh Lv.70) and Birth Island (Deoxys Lv.30) require the MysticTicket and AuroraTicket from 2004-05 Nintendo events; they are unreachable on an unmodified cartridge.

Version exclusives you must trade for: Sandshrew, Ekans/Arbok, Oddish line, Growlithe, Psyduck? (Psyduck is in both), Shellder, Electabuzz, Scyther are FireRed's side. Missing from FireRed: Vulpix, Bellsprout line, Meowth line, Magmar, Pinsir, Slowpoke line, Staryu — trade with LeafGreen.

Trade-evolve with a friend or a second game (needs a Wireless Adapter or link cable): Kadabra, Machoke, Graveler, Haunter; Onix + Metal Coat, Scyther + Metal Coat, Porygon + Up-Grade, Seadra + Dragon Scale, Poliwhirl/Slowpoke + King's Rock (Trainer Tower rewards).
Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald trades unlock after the Sapphire delivery, letting you complete the National Dex (386) with Hoenn Pokémon.
